name: Vorkath

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: Vorkath cycles melee, ranged and magic in no fixed order. None of them can be reacted to once launched.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep a protection prayer up the whole fight. Pick the style your gear handles worst.

mechanics.name: Deadly Dragonfire
mechanics.description: A dragonfire ball fired straight up that lands on the tile you are standing on. Neighbouring tiles still take half.
mechanics.counterplay: Step two tiles away as it launches. No dragonfire protection reduces this one.

mechanics.name: Zombified Spawn
mechanics.description: Icy breath freezes you in place and drops a zombified spawn across the arena. It walks at you and detonates on arrival.
mechanics.counterplay: Cast Crumble Undead to delete it instantly. Anything slower and you wear the explosion.

mechanics.name: Acid Phase
mechanics.description: Vorkath floods the arena with acid pools, then fires dragonfire at your position every tick until the phase ends.
mechanics.counterplay: Walk, never run, along a clear line of at least five tiles. Running spawns fresh acid behind you.

_observed: From a live kill on 2026-08-01, Vorkath played animations 7950 (on engage), 7952 (ranged attack, now claimed by standard-attacks), 7948 (idle), 7960 (once mid-fight, likely a special attack launch) and 7949 (death). Notably 7951 and 7957 never fired, so DS2_VORKATH_ATTACK_MELEE and DS2_VORKATH_ACID are not what the live boss uses for melee and the acid phase; they are kept only as harmless extra trigger ids. 7960 is left unassigned until a projectile id can be correlated with it by timestamp.
_note: Replaces the original skeleton data. NPC ids from gameval NpcID (VORKATH_SLEEPING_NOOP/SLEEPING/QUEST/VORKATH, VORKATH_SPAWN); projectile ids from gameval SpotanimID (VORKATH_RANGED_TRAVEL 1477, VORKATH_MAGIC_TRAVEL 1479, VORKATH_AREA_TRAVEL 1481, VORKATH_AREA_SMALL_TRAVEL 1482, VORKATH_ACID_TRAVEL 1483, VORKATH_SPAWN_TRAVEL 1484, VORKATH_AREA_TRAVEL_SMALL 2266); animations from gameval AnimationID (DS2_VORKATH_*). Deliberately omitted: the venomous and prayer-disabling dragonfire variants, which the wiki documents but which have no distinctly named projectile constant. Enable the debug trigger log during a fight to capture their ids, then add them as their own mechanics. See issue #10.
